en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until 9:30 a.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory extended the warning issued at 5:20 a.m., expecting a few squally thunderstorms over the territory this morning.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Thunderstorm Warning first issued at 5:20 a.m. on Wednesday has been extended until 9:30 a.m. A few squally thunderstorms are expected to occur over Hong Kong.

Special weather tips noted that thundery showers associated with an active southerly airstream were affecting the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary, with heavier rain possible in some areas over the territory in the next couple of hours.
Members of the public were advised to seek safe shelter if outdoors, leave the water and avoid outdoor water sports, and keep away from high ground, trees or highly conductive objects.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至上午9時30分
zh.dek: 天文台將清晨5時20分發出的雷暴警告延長至上午9時30分，預料本港有幾陣狂風雷暴。
body: 香港天文台表示，周三清晨5時20分發出的雷暴警告已延長至上午9時30分，預料本港有幾陣狂風雷暴。
特別天氣提示指出，活躍偏南氣流相關的雷雨影響珠江口一帶，未來兩三小時本港部分地區雨勢可能較大，市民早上出門前請留意天氣變化。
市民如身處室外，請到安全地方躲避；離開水面，切勿進行戶外水上活動；切勿站立高地或接近導電物體、樹木或桅杆。
